=={{header|Cxc}}==

<syntaxhighlight lang="elixir">
def main:
    use fs: FileSystem
    use console: Console

    -> running
        let content: String! = fs.read_text("input.txt") or IOError(reason: let m):
            console.write("read failed: " + m)
            ""
        let _n: Int = fs.write_text("output.txt", content) or IOError(reason: let m):
            console.write("write failed: " + m)
            0
        console.write("copied " + content.length().to_string() + " chars")
</syntaxhighlight>
